summary: The MaintSite page is part of the HSPnet system and is used for managing site information related to agencies. Users can view, edit, add, and manage site details, including addresses, contact information, governing organizations, and associated settings. The page includes functionalities for handling inactive sites, viewing site profiles, and linking to related services or destination masters.
purpose: The primary purpose of the MaintSite page is to facilitate the management of site information within the HSPnet system, ensuring that users can efficiently handle site records, update relevant data, and perform administrative actions such as activation or deactivation of sites.

workflows.name: Site Management
steps: Load page and check user permissions.
Populate dropdowns with agency and governing organization data.
Display site details in view or edit mode based on user input.
Handle add, edit, save, delete, and reactivate commands for sites.
Validate forms and perform actions based on user roles and permissions.

business_rules: Only sysadmins can add new sites.
The Governing Organization must be specified before saving.
Phone and fax must adhere to specified masks if enabled.
Sites cannot be deleted if associated services or destination codes exist.
Users cannot edit their own agency's site if they are not receiving users or sysadmins.
validations: Phone and fax format validation using client-side scripts.
Governing Organization validation to ensure it is not set to default.
Portfolio requirement validation if cost centers are used.
conditions: Display of 'Help' panel based on user view.
Visibility of 'RequestStudentNumber' checkbox based on configuration.
Dynamic adjustment of dropdown values and their visibility.
system_behavior: Populate dropdowns with data from the database.
Bind site data to form views for display and editing.
Register client scripts for page functionalities.
exceptions: User lacks permissions to edit or add sites due to role restrictions.
Validation errors when required fields are missing or incorrectly formatted.
